notes.subject: mɔgɔw / u
notes.rationale: Hebrew participles carry no explicit object; Bambara needs the persons acted upon.

notes.subject: ממית/ומחיה · מוריד/ויעל
notes.rationale: Two antithetical pairs — kills/makes-alive, brings-down/brings-up — pure parallelism, kept as pairs in Bambara.

notes.subject: Sheol
notes.rationale: Kept as Sheol, the world of the dead; not kɔgɔji (sea), not any hell-of-fire.

translation: Yawe bɛ ⟨mɔgɔw⟩ faga, ka ⟨u⟩ balo; a bɛ ⟨mɔgɔw⟩ bila Sheol, ka ⟨u⟩ wuli.
